avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Induces UGT1A4 and may increase lamotrigine metabolism, reducing serum levels and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consult prescriber before adding or discontinuing

avoid_supplements.name: Oral Contraceptives (Ethinyl Estradiol)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Estrogen induces UGT1A4, decreasing lamotrigine levels by 40-60%; conversely, lamotrigine may reduce oral contraceptive efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Monitor lamotrigine levels closely; may require dose adjustment; consider alternative contraception

caution_supplements.name: Folic Acid
caution_supplements.mechanism: Lamotrigine may deplete folate; supplementation supports overall health but does not directly interact pharmacokinetically

caution_supplements.name: Calcium and Vitamin D
caution_supplements.mechanism: Long-term anticonvulsant use may affect bone metabolism; supplementation may be beneficial
caution_supplements.action: Consider supplementation; assess bone health if prolonged therapy anticipated

caution_foods.name: High-Fat Meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May slightly delay absorption and peak levels of lamotrigine, though clinical significance is minimal
caution_foods.action: Take with or without food consistently; maintain stable dosing schedule

monitoring_notes: Monitor for lamotrigine level reduction with estrogen-containing products or UGT inducers; assess for rash (especially in first 8 weeks) and hepatic/renal function. Educate patient on medication adherence and potential enzyme induction interactions.
